title: orobus hupehensis
intro: Orobus hupehensis, commonly known as Chinese orchid tree or golden bell, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the family Fabaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and fever, as well as aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of Orobus hupehensis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antimicrobial properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. Additionally, Orobus hupehensis has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its ability to calm the mind and promote relaxation.
